from pathlib import Path
e=Path("docs/05_任务交接/P9_KNOWN_PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_PREFLIGHT_GATE_V1/evidence")

before=json.loads((e/"before.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
after=json.loads((e/"after.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

def digest(value): return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(value,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":")).encode()).hexdigest()
def metric(report,name): return report["metrics"][name]
t10_before=next(x for x in before["task_results"] if x["task_id"]=="T10")

delta={
 "schema":"known-payment-attempt-preflight-delta/v1",
 "target_sha256_before":freeze["target_sha256"],
 "target_sha256_after":hashlib.sha256(Path("samples/evaluation/project_impact_t10_preflight_target_v1.json").read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
 "runner_sha256_before":freeze["runner_sha256"],
 "runner_sha256_after":hashlib.sha256(Path("scripts/validation/run_project_impact_baseline.py").read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
 "non_t10_projection_sha256_before":digest(projection(before)),
 "non_t10_projection_sha256_after":digest(projection(after)),
 "non_t10_projection_exact_match":projection(before)==projection(after),
 "t10_before":{"decision":t10_before["actual"]["actual_decision"],"callback_count":t10_before["actual"]["actual_callback_count"]},
 "t10_after":{"decision":t10_after["actual"]["actual_decision"],"callback_count":t10_after["actual"]["actual_callback_count"],"preflight_status":t10_after["actual"]["known_payment_attempt_preflight_status"],"forbidden_side_effects":t10_after["actual"]["forbidden_side_effects"]},
 "metrics_before":before["metrics"],
 "metrics_after":after["metrics"],
 "repeatability_after":after["repeatability"],
 "project_impact_verdict_candidate":"IMPROVED",
 "scope_caveat":"GESR and product-observed authoritative trace remain 0/12 because B-03 is excluded",
}
(e/"delta.json").write_text(json.dumps(delta,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
checks={
 "target_hash_frozen":delta["target_sha256_before"]==delta["target_sha256_after"],
 "runner_hash_frozen":delta["runner_sha256_before"]==delta["runner_sha256_after"],
 "non_t10_exact_match":delta["non_t10_projection_exact_match"],
 "t10_before_allow_callback_1":delta["t10_before"]=={"decision":"ALLOW","callback_count":1},
 "t10_after_deny_callback_0":delta["t10_after"]["decision"]=="DENY" and delta["t10_after"]["callback_count"]==0,
 "duplicate_rate_after_zero":metric(after,"duplicate_or_forbidden_side_effect_rate")=={"count":0,"denominator":12,"rate":"0.000000"},
 "callback_match_after_full":metric(after,"callback_count_match_rate")=={"count":12,"denominator":12,"rate":"1.000000"},
 "repeat_three_identical":after["repeatability"]["all_identical"] and after["repeatability"]["repeat_count"]==3,
}
print(json.dumps(checks,sort_keys=True))
print("FINAL_AFTER_SHA256="+hashlib.sha256((e/"after.json").read_bytes()).hexdigest())
print("DELTA_SHA256="+hashlib.sha256((e/"delta.json").read_bytes()).hexdigest())
if not all(checks.values()): raise SystemExit(1)
